narrative.overview: Cinematic black-and-white architecture, split-line Manrope/Georgia hero, upright sans interior headings, neutral charcoal surfaces and restrained red actions. Full-width fictional website studies use the retained native horizontal gallery controller.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal, white/gray and #c82c19 red across agency routes.
Compact baseline-aligned pricing and preserved enquiry behavior.
Independent client templates and accessible motion/scrolling.

rules.name: Photo foreground
rules.body: Photographic text is explicitly white above a dark overlay. Verify the actual CSS cascade.

dos: Use real HTML text, controls and working routes.
Keep all gallery links accessible when selection changes.
Preserve preview restrictions, enquiry values and independent client templates.
donts: Do not restore the rejected paper collage.
Do not ship the approved screenshot as the complete site.
Do not trap native page scrolling.
Do not imply fictional studies are client commissions.
